agent_trajectories.thought: Deconstructing acoustic signals into temporal, spectral, and segmental phonemic layers. Detected phonemic substitution /r/ -> /w/ in initial position on target 'rabbit' and 'red' (confidence: 94%). Speaking rate measured at 52 WPM.
agent_trajectories.decision: Classified communication phenotype as MODERATE: Phonemic Articulatory Substitution (/r/ -> /w/) + Speech Initiation Hesitation.

agent_trajectories.observation: Historical trajectory retrieved for Arthur Vance (5 prior sessions). Baseline session pause: 2.6s, Session 5 pause: 1.3s.

However, initiation latency remains elevated at 1.4s preceding unvoiced fricatives. Lexical word-finding is intact; deficit resides in pre-motor planning.
